notes.type_correctness: getGlowCanvas returns HTMLCanvasElement | null with null guard in draw(); all canvas operations typed correctly; MANA_SVGS typed as Record<string, string>; ManaColor interface exported and used in MANA_COLORS.
notes.pattern_adherence: Dracula color tokens added to tailwind.config.js extend.colors — consistent with existing primary/accent token style. SVG preloading at mount via useEffect follows established hook pattern. No raw fetch anywhere.
notes.test_coverage: 8 new tests cover MANA_SVGS (5 keys, data URI format), MANA_SYMBOLS (5 WUBRG entries, no colorless), and MANA_COLORS (5 keys, dark+light strings). Canvas rendering logic in CardMatrix is not unit-tested, but that is expected for canvas animation code.
notes.security: MANA_SVGS values are static base64-encoded SVG data URIs embedded at compile time — no user input involved, no XSS vector. No new API calls or secrets introduced.
notes.architectural_alignment: Canvas animation stays inside backgrounds/ component tree. Dracula tokens are theme-layer concern placed correctly in tailwind config. Landing components stay in components/landing/. No cross-layer dependencies introduced.
